P \u2014 Permutation Sensitivity.correction_note: Original Theorem 1 stated L>=1; corrected to L>=2. L=1 is provably a boundary case (no permutation freedom).

N \u2014 Necessity (refined).correction_note: P3 is NOT individually necessary; reclassified as amplifying. P1, P2 remain necessary.

R \u2014 Polynomial Structure.claim: Delta_OSDS(L, m, d) and Delta_runtime(L, m, d) are polynomials in L of degree d+2 (compositional). The ratio rho(L, m, d) -> rho_inf(m, d) as L -> infinity, where rho_inf is the ratio of leading coefficients.
R \u2014 Polynomial Structure.scope_note: Holdout-verified for d=1 (m=1) and d=2 (m in {1,2,3}). Higher m and d=3,4 omitted: exact rational Lagrange interpolation at large L produces astronomical coefficient denominators whose equality test is the bottleneck. Polynomial-structure claim does not require exhausting the grid; structural induction in the proof handles all (m, d).

T4 \u2014 Degree Amplification (stratifi.verdict: Family-stratified SDR fits are the correct model: compositional caps are fit over degrees 1-8 and self-referential caps are fit separately over degrees 9-12. The pooled fit is retained as a diagnostic, not as the reported model, because mixed-family caps have different slopes and intercepts.

T5 \u2014 Entropy Decay.note: Constant > linear_decay > exponential_decay collapse trend reproduced under exact Fraction arithmetic. Absolute gamma values differ slightly between exact small-L and empirical large-L Monte Carlo; the ORDERING of gammas across schedules is preserved.
